items.title: 67250_John Collins oral history interview
items.q: Freddy Hubbard or whoever, they all recognize the -- that Dizzy Gillespie is the president.

ctx.x: Yeah, well we have a rapport, and you know, I've always known this and this is why I can appreciate this because this is why all trumpet players appreciate him too. You know, like trumpet players come and go, but they all bow down to Dizzy Gillespie. Now, that goes for Clifford Brown, Miles Davis, Contee Gondole or Freddy Hubbard or whoever, they all recognize the -- that Dizzy Gillespie is the president. Why? Because he -- his chordal sense, his harmonic sense is so great. Do you understand? This then is what…
